title: FoldKit: A Python library for efficient storage and retrieval of co-folding predictions
abstract: arXiv:2608.28788v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AlphaFold 3 (AF3) enables structure prediction of biomolecular complexes through co-folding multiple interacting molecules, making it increasingly useful for de novo protein design and for large-scale studies of protein-protein, protein-peptide, and other biomolecular interactions. However, systematic co-folding experiments can produce large volumes of output data, particularly when multiple random seeds and samples are generated for each input complex. We introduce FoldKit, a Python package for efficient storage and analysis of large-scale AF3 co-folding results. FoldKit converts raw AF3 outputs into a compact, structured representation while preserving the metadata needed for downstream analysis. The FoldKit Python library provides convenient programmatic access to global, single chain, and interface confidence metrics such as pLDDT, pTM, ipTM, ipAE, and ipSAE, as well as an ensemble-level interface for accessing and aggregating thes

translated_title: FoldKit：一个用于高效存储和检索共折叠预测的Python库
translated_abstract: AlphaFold 3（AF3）能够通过共折叠多个相互作用的分子来实现生物分子复合物的结构预测，这使其在从头蛋白质设计以及蛋白质-蛋白质、蛋白质-肽段和其他生物分子相互作用的大规模研究中日益有用。然而，系统性的共折叠实验可能产生大量的输出数据，尤其是当为每个输入复合物生成多个随机种子和样本时。我们推出了FoldKit，一个用于高效存储和分析大规模AF3共折叠结果的Python软件包。FoldKit将原始AF3输出转换为紧凑、结构化的表示形式，同时保留下游分析所需的元数据。FoldKit Python库提供了对全局、单链和界面置信度指标（如pLDDT、pTM、ipTM、ipAE和ipSAE）的便捷程序化访问，以及用于访问和聚合这些指标的系综级别接口。
tldr: FoldKit是一个Python库，可将大规模AlphaFold 3共折叠预测结果高效地存储为紧凑的结构化格式，并提供便捷的置信度指标访问与分析接口。
